dek: Hong Kong Customs yesterday (August 6) detected a case involving a local company that conducted cash and non-cash transactions of watches containing precious metals and stones valued at over HK$120,000, without registration under the Dealers in Precious Metals and Stones Regulatory Regime. The investigation is ongoing.
